sources.title: Introducing Perplexity Deep Research, official localized article
sources.evidence: Announces public web availability of Deep Research, iterative searches, document reading and reasoning to write reports with citations. Describes autonomous planning and search/coding capabilities. No parameter count or neural architecture is identified. The official archive separately dates this article February 14, 2025.

sources.title: Perplexity official blog archive
sources.evidence: The Introducing Perplexity Deep Research article is explicitly dated February 14, 2025; inspected HTML time datetime 2025-02-14T00:00:00.000Z. This is the application launch, not the later API expansion.

sources.title: Perplexity CEO announces Deep Research through the Sonar API
sources.evidence: Accessed original post through X official oEmbed and syndication JSON after the normal page was inaccessible. created_at is 2025-02-25T19:36:24.000Z. The CEO says Perplexity is making Deep Research available as an endpoint to all developers through the Sonar API, establishing the existing application feature to API lineage; it does not assert identical checkpoints.

sources.title: Official X syndication data for the API announcement
sources.evidence: Returns the original author, complete announcement text, post identifier and February 25, 2025 creation timestamp. Author metadata carries a Perplexity business affiliation. Independent X oEmbed endpoint returns the same text and date.

sources.title: Perplexity API changelog
sources.evidence: March 2025 Sonar search-mode update explicitly identifies Sonar Deep Research separately. May 2025 entries document exact sonar-deep-research reasoning_effort controls and asynchronous API. The retained March entry is not the original release date. No model weights, total or active parameter count or topology is provided.

sources.title: Sonar to Agent API migration documentation
sources.evidence: States Sonar Chat Completions support ended September 27, 2026. Synchronous and streaming calls continue via gradual reformulation into Agent API requests; asynchronous Sonar requests are no longer supported. Explicit mapping lists Sonar Deep Research to high effort. The new Agent API capabilities/model configurations do not establish specifications of the retired legacy model.

sources.title: March 19, 2025 Sonar model update
sources.evidence: Official dated article lists Sonar Deep Research as an existing distinct model exempted from the new high/medium/low search modes and citation-billing changes. This is family and named-identity corroboration, not a new release or a parameter disclosure.

sources.title: OpenRouter Sonar Deep Research endpoint specification
sources.evidence: Provider page identifies the exact model, 128,000-token context and text input/output. It describes repeated searches, reasoning and synthesis. March 7, 2025 is this provider listing date and does not supersede the earlier developer launch. Page says custom tools are not accepted; this differs from built-in research/search use.

sources.title: OpenRouter exact endpoint metadata
sources.evidence: Exact Perplexity endpoint lists context_length 128000 and text-to-text modalities. supported_parameters contains reasoning and web_search_options, not tools. The generic supports_tool_choice flags conflict with that list and are not used to claim custom function support. instruct_type deepseek-r1 is a formatting label, not proof that this exact hosted model uses an unchanged DeepSeek checkpoint.

sources.title: Perplexity API terms, January 23, 2026
sources.evidence: Terms explicitly cover Sonar and Agentic Research API services. Section 2.1 grants limited service-use rights; section 3.1 reserves Perplexity/licensor rights to models, algorithms and associated software. Supports the descriptive Proprietary service classification, not an open checkpoint license.

sources.title: DRACO first-party technical report, February 12, 2026
sources.evidence: Read the 38-page Perplexity/Harvard report. Section 5.1 explicitly evaluates the production Perplexity web endpoint with Opus 4.5 or 4.6 base models; Tables 8-10 report scores, inference tokens and latency. It does not identify legacy sonar-deep-research as those checkpoints or disclose its total/active parameters. Benchmark task, rubric and token counts are not parameter counts.

sources.title: Perplexity RL training research
sources.evidence: Accessed the opening methodology/infrastructure sections: it explicitly uses smaller open-source illustrative models and describes applying lessons to production. This is not an exact sonar-deep-research checkpoint architecture/count disclosure; no experimental model specifications are transferred.

sources.title: Perplexity speculative decoding research
sources.evidence: Accessed the article sections on autoregressive Transformers, Sonar speculative decoding and Llama-1B drafts, plus prospective DeepSeek-scale mechanisms. It does not bind the exact Sonar Deep Research variant to the described target architecture or a parameter count; generic Sonar/draft specifications are not transferred.

sources.title: Perplexity official public model listing
sources.evidence: Queried the official author inventory, which returned 27 public repositories and no Sonar Deep Research checkpoint. Together with the hosted service documentation and proprietary terms this supports retaining closed weights; other Perplexity releases are not this model.

sources.title: Legacy exact-model documentation URL
sources.evidence: The old model URL now redirects to the migration overview, so its former architecture/context body was not available. Do not treat the redirect as an accessed historical model card.

sources.title: Retained Sonar Deep Research model documentation
sources.evidence: Parent retrieved the retained exact model card directly with HTTP200. It explicitly documents Deep Research/reasoning, 128K context, repeated search, reasoning-token billing and report generation. The page is retained for customers with continued Sonar access and links the Agent API migration. No model parameter count or neural topology is disclosed. The older /docs/sonar path redirects, but this /docs/legacy/sonar path remains accessible.

name.note: Exact published Sonar API model identity; not the newer Agent API high effort configuration.

developer.note: Perplexity develops and offers this research system; no undocumented underlying-model author is substituted.

family.note: Explicit Sonar family grouping, normalized lowercase; this does not assert common weights with Sonar, Pro or Reasoning Pro.

release_date.note: Earliest public Deep Research application launch is February 14, 2025. The CEO February 25 announcement explicitly makes that existing Deep Research capability available through the Sonar API, establishing product/model lineage without proving an identical checkpoint. February 25 is API expansion; March 7 is OpenRouter listing. The baseline February 1 date has no primary support.

open_weights.note: Hosted proprietary research system; no exact public checkpoint in the accessed developer release materials or official public model inventory. Do not inherit openness from Sonar base-model ancestry, R1-1776 or newer Perplexity releases.

license.note: Descriptive classification under the Sonar API service terms, not an SPDX identifier or open-weight license.

parameters_b.note: No total model parameter count disclosed for the exact legacy Sonar Deep Research identity in the accessed primary materials and later first-party research checked. DRACO web-agent Opus variants, other Sonar/Llama targets, draft models and DeepSeek examples are not a verified backend mapping. The original model URL redirects; the retained legacy card is accessible and supplies no parameter count.

active_parameters_b.note: No exact-model active-per-token parameter count or defined accounting convention found in the accessed primary sources. Research steps, reasoning tokens, benchmark scores and inference token usage are not activated parameter counts.

architecture.note: Neural topology of this exact hosted research system remains undisclosed in accessed evidence. Iterative search/reasoning is an agent workflow, not a dense/MoE/Transformer architecture specification. Generic Sonar Transformer speculation research and OpenRouter instruct_type deepseek-r1 lack an exact backend binding; later web Deep Research Opus configurations are separate evidence.

context_window.note: Developer retained exact-model card documents nominal 128K context; the serving provider specifies 128,000 for this endpoint. This is the documented legacy API limit, not a claim of neural maximum or unchanged backend after migration.

modalities.note: Exact endpoint exposes text input and generated text. Citations, source URLs and document/report export are application metadata or formats. No image, audio or PDF-native neural input inferred from the broader application or replacement Agent API.

reasoning.note: Explicit exact sonar-deep-research reasoning_effort controls and reasoning-token behavior; original Deep Research description explains repeated planning and evidence synthesis.

tool_call.note: Verified built-in autonomous web-search use within the research workflow. This field includes built-in tools; it does not promise caller-defined function calls. The documented provider endpoint does not accept a tools schema, and replacement Agent API custom/MCP capabilities are not backported.

description.value: Research model that performs repeated web searches and produces reports with citations.
description.note: Replaces broad promotional wording with the documented research and cited-report behavior. Retirement and API remapping are recorded in notes.

patch.notes: Deep Research was publicly released in the Perplexity web app on February 14, 2025; the CEO explicitly announced its expansion through the Sonar API on February 25. This establishes lineage, not identical checkpoints. OpenRouter listed the API on March 7. Total/active parameters and exact neural architecture remain undisclosed in the accessed exact-model and later research sources. The retained developer model card specifies nominal 128K context; the provider specifies 128,000 tokens for this endpoint. Tool use means built-in autonomous searches; custom function calling is not supported by the documented provider endpoint. Sonar support ended September 27, 2026: synchronous/streaming calls are being reformulated as Agent API requests, while legacy asynchronous requests are no longer supported. Replacement Agent API or later Opus-based web-agent specifications are not assigned to this model.

summary: Audited all 14 fields. Corrected earliest public release to February 14, 2025 using the official app launch and CEO February 25 API-lineage bridge; distinguished March 7 provider listing. Added Proprietary classification, corrected tool use to built-in research/search, and simplified description. Retained 128,000 context, corroborated by the accessible developer legacy card at nominal128K, and text modalities. Exact counts and architecture remain undisclosed after later DRACO and training/speculation research checks; no sibling or replacement backend specifications transferred. Documented legacy September 27 retirement/remapping.
